entry.summary: No Smartraveller page and no current Tuvalu government page found. Secondary sites agree on a visitor permit on arrival for about one month with an onward ticket; they disagree on the fee (free or A$100 cash) and on extensions.
entry.next_check: Ask the Tuvalu High Commission or the Immigration Department in Funafuti about the fee and extensions.

seasons-and-flow.notes: Two distinct seasons. Visitor flow (peak and quiet months) is still to be read from the tourism authority's statistics.

sources.title: Climate change in the Pacific, Volume 2, Ch15-Tuvalu
sources.authority: Pacific Climate Change Science Program (Australian Bureau of Meteorology and CSIRO), 2011

culture-cycles.public_holidays: 11 in 2027 in data/calendar (machine data; the brief lists those in a trip window)
moving_calendars: Easter moves each year (2027: Good Friday and Easter Monday 2027-03-26, 2027-03-29)
culture-cycles.note: Festivals and community closures are still to be read from each place's own tourism office and communities.
